claim: Identify the actual integral two-chart pushout specialized to Q with the original global contact normalization, using the exact signed finite and infinity restriction maps, full categorical intersection and original Q-structure morphism.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required_input: Source and target must be the actual original schemes and ring maps.
obligations.constructed_input: Source is IntegralGluedModel.scheme Q c, target is ContactGlobalSmooth.Model c. Chart maps are spectra of the exact source, overlap and infinity algebra equivalences, not abstract chosen affine isomorphisms.
obligations.justification: Source is IntegralGluedModel.scheme Q c, target is ContactGlobalSmooth.Model c. Chart maps are spectra of the exact source, overlap and infinity algebra equivalences, not abstract chosen affine isomorphisms.

obligations.name: Index and chart coverage
obligations.required_input: All original root generators and every point of the global scheme must be covered.
obligations.constructed_input: Every Fin3 infinity ratio generator is tracked with original label j.succ. The full original Bool finite/infinity cover is used to construct the inverse. Both inverse laws use whole-chart hom extensionality.
obligations.justification: Every Fin3 infinity ratio generator is tracked with original label j.succ. The full original Bool finite/infinity cover is used to construct the inverse. Both inverse laws use whole-chart hom extensionality.

obligations.name: Coefficients and exceptions
obligations.required_input: Integral identities must not require a square-root choice or extra domain assumption.
obligations.constructed_input: Signed finite-root identities hold over arbitrary commutative R and four units. Rational field comparison specializes exactly R=Q and uses the already constructed original source field and its injective open embedding. No new exceptional prime claim is made.
obligations.justification: Signed finite-root identities hold over arbitrary commutative R and four units. Rational field comparison specializes exactly R=Q and uses the already constructed original source field and its injective open embedding. No new exceptional prime claim is made.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.required_input: Both atlas squares must commute on the complete overlap.
obligations.constructed_input: The finite square was proved through the whole original quartic localization. The infinity square is now proved by localized polynomial-base extensionality plus all three actual generators, then injectivity of the original field embedding.
obligations.justification: The finite square was proved through the whole original quartic localization. The infinity square is now proved by localized polynomial-base extensionality plus all three actual generators, then injectivity of the original field embedding.

obligations.name: Scalars and signs
obligations.required_input: Preserve u=c0/y0 and each signed root quotient y_j/y0.
obligations.constructed_input: The actual rootUnit inverse, original finite generator j, and original signed source root j.succ are mapped through the same field embedding. Ratios are never identified merely from their squares. Rational structure commutes by the actual chart scalar maps.
obligations.justification: The actual rootUnit inverse, original finite generator j, and original signed source root j.succ are mapped through the same field embedding. Ratios are never identified merely from their squares. Rational structure commutes by the actual chart scalar maps.

obligations.name: Identity and gluing
obligations.required_input: A comparison on a dense open does not identify the global normalization.
obligations.constructed_input: The map out of the original integral pushout is defined by pushout.desc. Its inverse is glued across the full original normalization cover using ContactFullOverlap.actual_pullback. Both compositions are the identity; originalModelIso packages them.
obligations.justification: The map out of the original integral pushout is defined by pushout.desc. Its inverse is glued across the full original normalization cover using ContactFullOverlap.actual_pullback. Both compositions are the identity; originalModelIso packages them.

obligations.name: Consumer
obligations.required_input: Retain the original finite and infinity embeddings and base map downstream.
obligations.constructed_input: Exact finite_toOriginal and infinity_toOriginal formulas identify the original chart embeddings. over_Q proves equality with the original normalization structure morphism, so this is a comparison of the original rational models over Q.
obligations.justification: Exact finite_toOriginal and infinity_toOriginal formulas identify the original chart embeddings. over_Q proves equality with the original normalization structure morphism, so this is a comparison of the original rational models over Q.

obligations.name: Remaining obligations
obligations.required_input: Do not infer arithmetic regularity or integral heights from rational scheme identity.
obligations.constructed_input: The original global bicanonical sections still need explicit functorial attachment to the integral glued tensor pair, and bad-prime regularity, actual all-place DVR/frame production, PEL and metric-height comparison remain open. This is specialization of the explicit ring construction to Q, not an unproved arbitrary-base-change theorem.
